messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] High tail latency + 5xx spike for model-family ceres-8k in prod (us-east-1). TPM ~2.6x baseline, queue depth rising. Paging eng-oncall.

mike: I'm on it — dashboards open. seeing queue growth on frontend pool pf-2 and backpressure in router.

jamal: any customer-facing 5xxs reported?

elaine: WidgetCorp and some internal smoke checks show ~30-50% 5xx for ceres-8k gen requests since 12:37 UTC.

mike: initial hypothesis: sudden burst of long-seq requests from a tenant causing KV cache thrash + GPU retry storms. mitigation plan: temporary per-model cap + disable function_call for ceres-8k, enable fallback to quant variant.

tess: sounds reasonable — what caps?

mike: propose tpm 1200 -> 300 and rpm 72k -> 9k for 15 minutes. also disable funcall on the ceres family until stable. Command I'm going to run: 
```
POST /admin/quotas/update 
{
  "model_family": "ceres-8k",
  "tpm": 300,
  "rpm": 9000,
  "duration_mins": 15
}
```

jamal: +1. disabling funcall reduces downstream token churn. can you also scope to non-enterprise tenants first?

mike: I'll scope to public/non-enterprise first (tenant != enterprise-*) — running now.

deploy-bot: quota change applied for ceres-8k — tpm=300 rpm=9000 (scoped public tenants) by mike at 12:45:10 UTC :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Observability update: 30s after quota change p99 latency down ~45%, 5xx rate in affected clusters dropped from 38% -> 6%. Queue depth falling.

elaine: CS update: WidgetCorp ticket filed earlier — they confirm fewer errors but intermittent slow responses. I've flagged as priority; keeping them updated.

cs-bot: Ticket #INC-4512 created and linked to this incident. WidgetCorp notified via email and Slack.

tess: taking over on-call. mike — quick handoff summary?

mike: Handoff notes: applied rapid per-model cap to ceres-8k (public tenants), disabled function_call for ceres-8k, enabled routing fallback to ceres-8k-quant where available. Suspect tenant-423 bursty job — investigating. Next steps: check KV cache hit-rate, look for repeated bulk jobs from tenant-423, tune eviction thresholds. ETA 30m for deeper analysis. Escalate to eng-runtime if error rate rebounds.

jamal: adding that we should consider a short-lived circuit-breaker for heavy seq-length requests on this family if this recurs.

mike: agree. I'll also capture a short perf profile and upload to the incident doc.

tess: ack. I'll monitor metrics and CS thread, let me know if anything changes. If 5xx >10% again, I will widen caps to enterprise-only or pause ceres-8k for public tenants.

mike: leaving channel — reachable via pager. :wave:

tess: thanks — taking over. will post status updates every 10m. :white_check_mark:
